capt_pfd.purpose:
👉 It’s a no-go takeoff warning — the airplane is telling you:
“Configuration is not safe for takeoff—fix before departure.” TEST
causes: Stabilizer trim not in takeoff range
In Flight (AIR) – No warning or false warning
On Ground – No warning or false warning
S1049 – Ground spoiler up pressure switch
capt_pfd.bite:
PSEU
TOW (Takeoff Warning) BITE Test – 

Turn PSEU BITE panel ON
Scroll to GROUND TESTS? → press YES
Scroll to T/O WARN TEST? → press YES

Results

TEST PASS → System OK
Maintenance message shown → Go to FIM / message index for troubleshooting

P18-2 D9 – STBY ATT IND
P6-3 B9 – PANEL & INSTR 28V PRI CAPT & CTR

causes: Failed or weak wheel speed sensor
👉 Causes loss of wheel speed → antiskid disables
Fails BITE or shows maintenance messages
anti_skid_inop.bite:
FIM Task 32-42-00-810-801    E1-3 RACK
Antiskid/Autobrake Control Unit (AACU) BITE Procedure
anti_skid_inop.breakers:
P6-3 E16 LANDING GEAR ANTISKID INBD
P6-3 E18 LANDING GEAR ANTISKID OUTBD
anti_skid_inop.full:
1. Fault Memory Recall

Set PRESS/TEST-BIT switch → BIT

Check display:

TEST END → No faults stored
Message shown → Fault exists

If message shown:

Write down maintenance message
Press BIT again to scroll next fault
Continue until TEST END

⚠️ If no action within ~45 sec → display clears

2. Display (Lamp/Segment) Test

Set switch → PRESS/TEST
Verify:

Display shows checkerboard pattern (all segments ON)
ANTI SKID INOP light illuminates

3. If Faults Found
A. Missing Display Segments

Replace AACU (M162)
Perform AACU BITE again
If no message → problem fixed


B. ANTI SKID INOP Light does NOT illuminate


Press-to-test light (L2, P2-2 panel)

If fails → replace bulb or troubleshoot dim/test circuit


Check wiring continuity from:

Light connector D339 pin 8 →

D11402 pin 5 (Relay R626)
D11406 pin 5 (Relay R628)
D11404 pin 3 (Relay R627)

If no continuity → repair wiring

SPIN UP ADAPTOR LOCATION AT ORD 105 - A  A32075-10
